column1: # P/05 refusal catalogue, form norm; literal TAB, no CSV quoting. Original four N4 cells are preserved on every projection.
# Several fixed HTTP outcomes of one source row have the same row, unique names. Every source row remains represented.
# response_schema names components/schemas of 05-resource.api.openapi.yaml, - means no body/text or a non-HTTP result.
# kind=-: P05 has no Fault.kind discriminator. ResourceError.error is arbitrary non-empty text; ResourceDenied.error is const refused in its schema.
# fields includes the schema required fields; optional or conditional output fields, headers and const values remain those of the OpenAPI and normative cells.
# Numeric codes206/200 in the original refusal table (Range and hint full/replaced, skipped lines) are retained, not turned into errors.
# Resource ceilings by their own table and writer/retention outcomes are call surfaces here, not an invented fixed status.
